categories.evidence: Carries the Wallet label, modifies src/wallet/wallet.cpp, src/wallet/walletdb.cpp, and removes transaction deletion code from the wallet database.
categories.rationale: Removing deprecated RPCs and dead transaction deletion logic eliminates wallet maintenance burdens and footguns. Completing the deprecation cycle for `removeprunedfunds` and deleting `CWallet::RemoveTxs` simplifies wallet internals without affecting normal balance accounting.
